label: Stage 1 Finding Stability
description: Test whether an approved Stage 1 differential-expression finding survives a declared adjusted-p threshold sweep. Use for robustness or threshold-sensitivity questions, not merely because it is available.

entrypoints.summary: Sweep the adjusted-p cutoffs over the frozen differential-expression table and report how many features pass each.

thresholds.description: Adjusted p-value cutoffs to sweep, each between 0 and 1.
